title: X-Force Minus 1 July - 1991 Series Marvel Comics Group Flashback - Adam Pollina
descriptionText: The product is a single comic book from the X-Force Minus 1 July - 1991 Series by Marvel Comics Group, featuring artwork by Adam Pollina. This comic book is part of the US Comics tradition and belongs to the Marvel Universe, with the X-Force superhero team as the main character. Published by Marvel in 1991, this English-language comic book is boarded and features the modern age of superheroes. A sought-after collectible for fans of the X-Force series.
